nodes.label: Linea — editorial concept-store Shopify theme (accent #9A3B2C)
nodes.rationale: Quiet-luxury editorial design system: paper & ink palette, hairline grid, zero corner-radius, no drop-shadows; Fraunces high-contrast serif display paired with Inter grotesk body and Space Mono micro-labels; asymmetric split hero, slow marquee, staggered Edit grid, manifesto sections.
